idleAgentsHint: Finished agents free memory after this timeout. Chats resume from saved history. Running tasks and approvals remain active.
mcpViaCli: Manage {name} MCP servers with {cmd} in a terminal. New chats use the CLI configuration.
title: Settings
autoTitlesHint: After the first reply, Haiku comes up with a short title
notificationsHint: When Claude finishes while the window is minimized or another chat is open
followUpHint: “Steer” — Claude picks up your note at the next step without stopping. “Queue” — the message is sent after the reply
defaultsHint: These values are applied to every new chat. You can change them per chat in the composer.
workModeHint: Worktree — a separate copy of the repo on its own branch
chromeHint: Claude controls your Chrome through the Claude extension (tabs, clicks, forms). Applies to new and restarted sessions
builtinBrowserHint: Always available to Claude as desk-browser tools; open it with the globe button in the chat header
claudeFooter: MCP servers, skills and usage are in the neighboring sections.
key_slash: Commands and skills (in an empty input)
key_multiSelect: Select multiple chats in the list
key_split: Open chat side by side (split view)
mcpIntro: The same servers Claude Code uses. Servers from claude.ai connectors and plugins are managed where they're configured; you can add your own here.
mcpRemoveMessage: Server “{name}” will be removed from Claude Code settings.
mcpAdded: {name} added — the server will be available in new sessions
skillsIntro: Skills, commands and plugin commands the agent can use. The agent picks skills on its own; Claude's are also available through "/" in the composer.
statsIntro: Based on Claude's replies in Duet (since usage tracking was added). Cost uses API pricing; for subscriptions it's for reference only.
aboutIntro: Duet — a personal interface to Claude Code via the Agent SDK and your subscription.
updateAppHint: Rebuild the UI from the project folder and restart the window. Open sessions continue after the restart.
installedHint: The installed version is updated with a new installer (npm run dist).
agentHint: Which agent new chats talk to. Any chat can switch agents later and keeps its conversation.
key_switchAgent: Switch the chat to another agent
mcpIntroCodex: MCP servers Codex uses: from ~/.codex/config.toml and its plugins. Changes are written with codex mcp add/remove; reload applies them.
